notes: Gale Queen, generic 21.0 m steel island passenger ferry (6.24 m over fenders, 10.9 m keel to masthead, draught 1.85 m: ATT_Waterline 5.55 studs above the base pivot). Replaces RescueService.buildFerry greybox. MAPPING greybox -> asset: Hull 16x7x60 + Keel -> MeshParts Hull (shell + transom, bbox 18.0 x 11.9 x 62.8 studs, its Size.Z is the HullKnock length; 5 compartments at -25.2/-12.6/0/12.6/25.2 studs along Z = ATT_Knock_01..05 on the Roblox +X bilge, the side that is up at the 72 deg roll) + HullGear (bar keel, skeg, bilge keels, rudders, A-brackets, thruster) + Props (twin screws, anodes); Deckhouse -> Saloon (+ Windows, Decks); Bridge -> Wheelhouse; Funnel -> Funnel (+ Mast cap, radar, lights); LifeRaft x5 cylinders -> Rafts (4 GRP canisters on cradles + 6 lifebuoys; ATT_Liferaft_01..04); 'GALE QUEEN' SurfaceGui -> Decals (bows, transom, draught marks, signs; AlphaMode Transparency added in tools/gen_asset_ids.py). Also Bulwark, Rails, DeckGear, Fenders, GrabLines (5 girth lines at the compartments + bilge jackstay; hide when upright). C2b STATE PARTS: Damage (capsized only: buckled -X upper deck rail, canister 4 torn from its cradle and jammed in the rail on its painter, smashed wheelhouse -X side + front panes, loose lines over the -X bulwark hanging into the sea with a lifebuoy and a fender; posed for the 72 deg roll) and Undamaged (upright only: the straight -X upper rail run + canister 4); show Undamaged upright, Damage + GrabLines when capsized. Integration: keep the greybox tilt CFrame.Angles(0,0,rad(72)) on this one model (bottom antifouling + slime/weed/barnacles reads when lying over or turned turtle); hull_knock.luau FindFirstChild('Hull') needs the Hull MeshPart named 'Hull' (or a Hull proxy part); its bbox centre is 7.2 studs above the base. Other ATT_: Bow, Stern, Masthead, AirPocket, BoardingGate_Port/Stbd. LOD0 26,788 tris in 18 MeshParts (max 6,301), LOD1 9,763, LOD2 7,224 (big_ship 90k/30k/8k). 6 sets x 1024 + _Wet: Hull, Super, Deck, Fittings, Glass, Decals; Hull, Super, Deck also ship NOR_Wet (streaming-water rivulets). C2b textures: faded patchy antifouling (3 coats, chalking, primer and old-coat windows, slipway scrapes to rust), keel-to-waterline fouling gradient (diatom film, slime, weed band, barnacle band), scupper rust runs, salt tide marks, varied paint wear, deck grit grime, oil and rust blooms; wet sets darker and glossier everywhere. _COL 6 boxes.
